name: connection-modal
scenario: Add a modal dialog to configure a new database connection: a form with host/port/credentials fields, client-side validation, and a single API call to test-and-save the connection.
signal_summary: One new component, one new endpoint call, no cross-module coupling, no step depends on another unit's completion.
expect_reason: Small, self-contained surface with no independent verification boundaries — a single phase covers the whole change.
